title: Correct time interval formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive or state the final expression Δt' = (v_p - v_s)/(v_p - v_A) * Δt.

title: Correct frequency formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive or state the final expression f' = (v_p - v_A)/(v_p - v_s) * f.

title: Proper wave propagation analysis
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly set up equations for the distances traveled by the sound signals and the moving source/observer.

title: Relates period to time interval
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly connect the received time interval Δt' to the received period T' and the emitted period T.

title: Consistent sign convention
description: Important Criteria: The derivation must use a consistent sign convention for velocities along the positive x-axis.

title: Unit analysis or check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may perform a dimensional analysis to verify the formulas are dimensionally consistent.

title: Incorrect relative velocity
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses v_p + v_s or v_p + v_A in the numerator or denominator.

title: Confuses period and frequency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student inverts the relationship between period and frequency when deriving f'.
